name: Coinbase Card
summary: Coinbase Card is a Visa debit card that lets you spend crypto anywhere Visa is accepted. Earn up to 4% back in crypto rewards on purchases. Available to verified Coinbase users in the US.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required

faq.question: Does the Coinbase Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Coinbase Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the Coinbase Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
